\chapter{Learning Theory — Regret}
%%% generated by the blueprint pipeline from TCSlib.LearningTheory.Hedge.Regret
\section{Overview}

This module proves the no-regret guarantees for the Hedge algorithm in the expert
setting via the potential argument of Cesa-Bianchi--Lugosi (Thm.\ 2.2) and
Freund--Schapire: a per-round bound on the change of the log potential
$\log W_{t+1} - \log W_t$ is telescoped over the $T$ rounds and combined with the lower
bound $W_T \ge e^{-\eta\,\mathrm{bestExpertLoss}}$ to give
$\mathrm{regret} \le (\log N)/\eta + cT/\eta$.  It also contains the elementary
balancing identity behind the optimized learning rates $\eta = \sqrt{c \log N / T}$.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
\section{Declarations}

\begin{lemma}[Telescoping log potential]
\lean{log_potential_telescope}
\label{log_potential_telescope}
\leanok
\uses{LossSeq, potential}
\difficulty{3}
For any natural numbers $N,T$, any real learning rate $\eta$, and any loss sequence
$\ell$ for $N$ experts over $T$ rounds, the successive changes in the logarithm of the
potential sum to the total change: $\sum_{t\in\mathrm{Fin}\,T}\bigl(\log W_{t+1}-\log
W_t\bigr)=\log W_T-\log W_0$, where $W_t$ is the sum of the Hedge weights at time $t$.
\end{lemma}

\begin{lemma}[Regret from a per-step log-potential bound]
\lean{regret_le_of_log_potential_step}
\difficulty{5}
\statementsource{roughgarden-agt-l17-noregret}{
  pdf-eda737ce3103-p006-b001,
  pdf-eda737ce3103-p006-b002,
  pdf-eda737ce3103-p006-b003,
  pdf-eda737ce3103-p007-b001
}
\statementsource{freund-schapire-adaptive-game-playing}{
  pdf-9c61a2f1ecc1-p004-b002,
  pdf-9c61a2f1ecc1-p004-b003,
  pdf-9c61a2f1ecc1-p004-b004
}
\label{regret_le_of_log_potential_step}
\leanok
\uses{LossSeq, bestExpertLoss, hedgeCumLoss, hedgeLoss, log_potential_telescope, potential, potential_ge_best_expert, potential_zero, regret}
Let $N \ge 1$, let $\eta > 0$, let $\ell$ be a loss sequence for $N$ experts over $T$
rounds, and let $c \in \bbr$.  Suppose that for every round $t < T$ the log potential
satisfies the one-step bound
\[
  \log W_{t+1} - \log W_t \;\le\; -\eta \cdot \mathrm{hedgeLoss}_t + c ,
\]
where $\mathrm{hedgeLoss}_t$ is the expected loss of Hedge in round $t$.  Then the
regret of Hedge is bounded by
\[
  \mathrm{regret}(\eta,\ell) \;\le\; \frac{\log N}{\eta} + \frac{c\,T}{\eta} .
\]
\end{lemma}

\begin{lemma}[Balance of two positive terms]
\lean{optimalEta_balance}
\label{optimalEta_balance}
\leanok
\difficulty{5}
For positive real numbers $a$, $T$, and $c$,
\[
\frac{a}{\sqrt{ca/T}}+\frac{T\sqrt{ca/T}}{c}=\sqrt{\frac{4aT}{c}}.
\]
\end{lemma}
